description: Return each company's hiring picture right now: open roles by role family and function, leadership and founding roles, tools its roles name, a hiring stance (building go-to-market, building leadership, scaling engineering, frozen, ...) and its hiring signals from the last 90 days. Takes up to 25 companies by domain, LinkedIn URL, id or name. Costs one credit per profile returned. A company we have not read yet comes back as building and is read straight away; ask again in a few minutes.

companies.description: Up to 25 companies, each a domain (stripe.com), a LinkedIn company URL, a Datahyena company id, or a name.
